import { v, validate } from "@warlock.js/seal";

const rowSchema = v.object({ sku: v.string() });

export async function parseRow(row: unknown) {
  const result = await validate(rowSchema, row);
  return result.data.sku;
}

export async function parseChecked(row: unknown) {
  const checked = await validate(rowSchema, row);
  if (!checked.isValid) return undefined;
  return checked.data.sku;
}
